A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Dualformer work. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices support reliable comparison despite reformatting and section relocation.

before.justification: v2 reports original Maze, Sokoban and math-reasoning experiments, including baseline comparisons, ablations and generalization tests.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds a qualitative comparison of fast- and slow-mode maze solutions.

M1.justification: The four structured trace-dropping levels, randomized training, model architectures, control-token inference and math-reasoning adaptation are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Maze, Sokoban and MATH/Aug-MATH coverage, including wall-density and rectangular-maze tests. The new illustration remains within the existing maze task.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Solution-Only, Complete-Trace, bootstrapped Searchformer, Mix-p variants and the same math-model baselines. The o1-preview and o1-mini case comparisons are also retained.

E3.justification: Model sizes, training budgets, data selection, metrics and evaluation procedures match. These include 64 responses per navigation task and the Greedy@1 and Pass@20 math evaluations. The new illustration documents no changed protocol.

E4.justification: v3 adds Appendix B/Figure B.1, a distinct maze case contrasting a suboptimal fast-mode route with an optimal slow-mode route. Existing dropping-strategy ablations, Mix-p comparisons, generalization tests and other case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports training-seed comparisons, independent repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. Response-sampling and aggregation practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Main Tables 5.1–5.8 in v2 match Tables 4.1–4.8 in v3, and the appendix result tables retain their values. Figure B.1 adds the qualitative finding that fast mode misses an optimal route found by slow mode in the displayed example.

T1.justification: The trace-dropping definitions, categorical sampling formulation and SWC expression are retained. The A* preliminaries move to Appendix A without substantive mathematical revision; no new theorem or proof appears.

C1.justification: v3's abstract newly claims greater reasoning-trace diversity than Searchformer, whereas v2's introduction emphasized diversity of final plans. The core controllability, accuracy, efficiency and math-generalization claims otherwise remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The new Figure B.1 identifies a critical cell missed by fast thinking as an explanation for the displayed suboptimal route. Existing interpretations concerning plan memorization, difficulty-dependent mode selection and OOD failures remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Architecture details, hyperparameters, hardware and training times, dataset-selection instructions, prompts and access information are retained across the renamed appendices. Moving the existing code link into the abstract does not establish new availability.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to Searchformer, external controllers, distillation and token masking remain unchanged. Reference edits concern formatting and bibliographic presentation.

P1.justification: The abstract and opening motivation are tightened and refocused. Preliminaries move from Section 3 to Appendix A, with a short replacement summary in the method section; most remaining prose is retained.

P2.justification: v3 adopts an ICLR layout throughout, replacing the title panel and changing typography, margins, table scaling, figure placement and appendix pagination. It also adds Figure B.1 and relocates the tokenization illustration to Appendix A.

improvement.justification: The tighter introduction and new Figure B.1 make the fast/slow accuracy tradeoff more concrete, providing a modest explanatory improvement. Quantitative validation and reproducibility remain unchanged. The added abstract claim about reasoning-trace diversity is not separately quantified beyond the retained plan-diversity analysis.
